California Fujiizumi is so last year.
Right now it's all about "Michael Le Michael", duh. Never heard of 'em?

And then there's stuff like this too~
Isn't this, like, so cute~♪
...Gonna take a pic for now.

You don't know this either? Like, seriously,
do you even look at social media?

Ah, gotcha. I don't really watch TV much.
Though I might barely know some shows or comedians. Try me.

However, nothing immediately came to mind either, so I reluctantly
mentioned a show I used to watch as a kid called "Laugh Derby", but...

...Never heard of it~. Besides, there's no way I'd know
ancient stuff like that. Is it uploaded on UmaTube?

I mean... it's kind of like
talking to my parents, y'know?

Like, if you don't get UmaTok,
what do you even watch? What makes you laugh?

Making sure she was watching, I took a deep breath.
Recalling the video I had watched over and over again—

I mean, technically, but that's totally off~!
Whoa, you seriously don't know it?

Anyway, our meeting's pretty much over, right?
I'm outta here. Later~

...You went outta your way to study it?
Huh...

...Thinking back, I'd been so busy lately that I hadn't
kept up with entertainment at all. So I could only give generic answers.

Hey~!
Don't make me flop like that!

Hm? What's up?
...You got a scary look on your face. Whoa, creepy, what is it?

I wanted to understand what she liked—so I followed
the comedian she had just mentioned and other trending UmaTokkers.

"Hoppin' Panpopin'"!!
C'mon, that's so cringe~! Don't make me do that~! Ahaha!

He does these super goofy gags,
and he's blowing up like crazy on UmaTok right now.

...It seemed bridging the generation gap between myself
and Toosen Jordan was going to take a lot more effort.
—Ahahaha! That's so insane~!!

Jordan, check this one out too!
Isn't it crazy?!

Wait, then~ what about this one?
...Pfft, haha...

Then how about something like this?
~♪

...I didn't quite get it, but it looked fun. Curious,
I thought about asking her during our meeting, but—

Hmm. Well, it is super recent, I guess.
If it's not a comedy bit, would you know it?

Totally flopped, though~.
Alright, take two. I'm posting this to UmaTok, so give it your all~.
...Huh?

Really? What's with the sudden interest anyway~?
You totally ignored me when I dropped a punchline earlier.

It's "Waranouchi Ukemaro~"... y'know?
You've seriously never heard of him?!
...Huh?

...For real! Ahaha, no way,
my stomach hurts... Ahaha, that is way too stupid~.

So, how old is that bit anyway?
Man, haven't seen that in ages.

Startled by the sudden burst of laughter, I looked over...
Toosen Jordan and her friend were cracking up looking at a phone.

The worlds we lived in were just too different... At this rate, I wouldn't
be able to understand her, and we'd end up talking past each other.

—I told you~.
It's "California Fujiizumi."
And so, after days of intensive research—a few days later.
